selected_script.angle: A flat sponge keeps sliding over recessed grout and wasting effort; the V-shaped stand-up brush drops into the line so the professional-strength formula can work where the grime actually sits.
selected_script.hook: That flat sponge is riding right over the dirty grout.

script_record.pain_point: Flat cleaning tools glide across tile surfaces but fail to reach recessed dirty grout lines, making the user repeat the same spot without seeing a real clean line.
script_record.conflict_hook: A close-up shows a flat yellow sponge dragging over a dark grout line between ceramic tiles, smearing cleaner on the tile while the grime remains in the groove.
script_record.product_solution: The white 32 oz Grout-eez bottle with red and blue label is applied to the grout line, then the bright blue V-shaped stand-up brush with white twisted bristles fits directly into the grout groove and scrubs while the user stands.

timeline.scene: Tight close-up on a ceramic tile floor in a busy hallway. A hand pushes a flat sponge across a dark grout line; the sponge rides over the recessed line and leaves the grime visible. Quick cut to the user's frustrated hand pressing harder, but the grout still looks dark. Spoken hook: “That flat sponge is riding right over the dirty grout.”

The Grout Cleaner Kit enters the same floor scene. Show the white Grout-eez bottle with red and blue label beside the bright blue V-shaped brush head. Cleaner is applied along the grout line, then the blue V-shaped brush attached to a standard threaded pole drops into the groove and scrubs forward in one clean standing motion.

Fast-cut hallway result: the V-shaped brush moves down one grout line, dense white twisted bristles flex inside the groove, and a wipe/mop pass reveals a visibly cleaner line between ceramic tiles. Product remains in frame next to the cleaned section.

Different environment: bathroom vanity tile floor. Low angle shows the blue brush head swiveling around the vanity base while staying in the grout line. Quick shot of the Grout-eez bottle standing upright nearby, label facing camera.

Kitchen tile floor final pass. The user stands upright and pushes the pole smoothly across several grout lines. Cut to a clean, brighter-looking grout path with the white bottle and blue brush head placed together on the floor, maintaining exact product colors, shape, and size ratio.
Clean floor beauty shot with product centered. On-screen text and voiceover: “Clean the line, not just the tile.”

voiceover.line: That flat sponge is riding right over the dirty grout.
This kit targets the line instead.
Formula on the grout, V-shaped brush in the groove.
No tiny brush, no awkward scrubbing.
Just stand up and work the grout lines.
Clean the line, not just the tile.

on_screen_text.text: Clean the line, not just the tile

script_record.cta: Clean the line, not just the tile.
compliance_notes: Show safe use only on ceramic or porcelain tile.
Do not show natural stone surfaces.
Do not add a pole as a packaged accessory; if shown, it is a standard threaded pole attached for use.
Keep the bottle white with red and blue label, ribbed neck, white cap, and logo placement unchanged.
Keep the brush bright blue with dense white twisted nylon bristles and V-shaped low profile unchanged.

Do not change the product color, shape, material, size ratio, logo position, texture, or visible structure. The product must remain a white 32 oz Grout-eez cleaner bottle with a red and blue front label, ribbed white neck, white cap, and a bright blue V-shaped grout brush head with dense white twisted nylon bristles and an angled threaded socket. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, packaging, or exaggerated functions. Use the detail and side reference image to preserve product material, side structure, edge shape, texture, and visible details. Use the function reference image only to understand the real product usage. Do not invent new functions. Create realistic US home footage, handheld phone camera, fast-cut pacing, natural indoor lighting, no polished studio look.

The hand presses harder for a second, but the dark line remains. Do not show the product yet. Add spoken hook: “That flat sponge is riding right over the dirty grout.” On-screen text: “Flat sponge = missed grout.”
3-6s: Quickly introduce the product as the direct solution and show the issue being fixed immediately. Cut to the white Grout-eez bottle with red and blue label placed beside the same dirty grout line, with the bright blue V-shaped brush head visible next to it. Apply cleaner directly along the grout line. The blue V-shaped brush, attached to a standard threaded pole for use, drops into the groove and scrubs forward while the user stands. Voiceover: “This kit targets the line instead.” On-screen text: “Target the line.”
6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result. Show close-up bristles flexing inside the grout groove, then a quick wipe or mop pass reveals a cleaner-looking grout line between ceramic tiles. Keep the bottle and blue brush visible in the scene, product central and easy to recognize. Voiceover: “Formula on the grout, V-shaped brush in the groove.” On-screen text: “V-shaped brush reaches deeper.”
